record.question: A New Drug Application (NDA) is submitted in which stage of the clinical trial?
record.explanation: Answer C: After successful completion of Phase 3. A New Drug Application is generally submitted after clinical development, including successful Phase III trials, to request marketing approval. Source/context note: Terminology and submission sequence vary between countries and development pathways. Reference: https://www.fda.gov/patients/drug-development-process/step-4-fda-drug-review. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
